note: Observed data only. No value is a share of operated flights.

conditions.eurostat: avia_paoa, unit FLIGHT, tra_meas CAF_PAS (commercial passenger air flights, arrivals + departures), schedule TOTAL, tra_cov TOTAL
conditions.ours: departures + arrivals at the airport in the Explore month files (both bases); class = aircraft-variant class, not the purpose of the flight

method: Ratios are descriptive. The definitions differ (Eurostat: commercial passenger flights reported by the airport; ours: ADS-B flights with an airline code and an assigned airport, classed by aircraft), so agreement is not accuracy. C1_scaled multiplies by calendar/effective days of the EU daily series (experimental).
